description: Source code for GPIO driver for Atmel SAM4L microcontroller in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, control, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO port pins with specified mask and flags.

methods.name: gpio_sam_config
methods.description: Configures a specific GPIO pin with given flags.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits with mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for port with mask, mode, and trigger.

methods.name: gpio_sam_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a specific pin.

methods.name: gpio_sam_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO interrupts.
